name: Mixed-type quote category-bucket isolation (Software+Services+Subscription+Hardware on one quote)
expected: On a mixed-type quote each line routes to exactly one category subtotal with no cross-contamination/double-counting, and the buckets sum to the header. Catalog test_setup posits FOUR buckets (Total Software / Total Services / Total Subscription / Hardware) where 'Software perpetual' lands in Total Software and a Hardware Power line lands in a Hardware subtotal.
actual: Real UI-priced multi-type quote 0Q0WC0000034UvR0AU (10 lines, USD), V21 Force-reprice isSuccess=true errorResponse=[] CalculationStatus=CompletedWithPricing (LMD 2026-06-30T01:39:54Z). ISOLATION HOLDS EXACTLY: Total_Software__c=27354 (=0+27354, the two Fortra_Product_Type__c='Software' lines only), Total_Services__c=24275 (=275+24000), Total_Subscription__c=5775.5 (=1733+4042.5). No line counted twice (each Total* step is an AdvancedListFilter Equals one literal -> mutually exclusive). BUT buckets do NOT sum to header: 27354+24275+5775.5=57404.5 vs Subtotal/TotalPrice/GrandTotal/ALE=74909.5. Gap=17505.0 = the three Fortra_Product_Type__c='Perpetual' lines (7350+3675+6480) which match NO bucket filter. Header Subtotal=SUM(all 10 non-derived line NetTotalPrice)=74909.5 (correct, authoritative). The catalog's premise of a FOURTH 'Hardware' bucket and Software-bucket capture of perpetual software is false: Fortra_Product_Type__c has NO 'Hardware' value (0 rows org-wide; Power products carry Perpetual/Subscription/Renewal Maintenance), and Quote.Hardware__c is DataType=Lookup(Hardware) (a record reference), not a currency subtotal. V21 has exactly THREE category buckets (literal filters 'Software'/'Services'/'Subscription'); Perpetual/Renewal Maintenance/New Maintenance/Change Fee/null types intentionally have no bucket.
evidence: Quote https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC0000034UvR0AU/view (SW=27354 SVC=24275 SUB=5775.5; Subtotal=TotalPrice=GrandTotal=ALE=74909.5); reprice resp scratchpad c07_resp.json isSuccess=true; V21 step XML scratchpad step_Total_Software.xml/step_Total_Services.xml/step_Total_Subscription.xml (AdvancedListFilter Equals Fortra_Product_Type__c) + step_Software/Services/Subscription_Aggregate_Price.xml (SUM ItemNetTotalPrice -> Total_*__c); step_Total_Amount.xml + Subtotal Aggregate (DerivedPricingAttribute isFalse gate); org type distribution: Software 174 / Services 16173 / Subscription 365080 / Perpetual 144207 / Renewal Maintenance 498250 / New Maintenance 68607 / null 130809 / Change Fee 509 / Hardware 0
proposedFix: No procedure change required for the tested mechanism. The catalog expectation is wrong on two counts: (1) there is no 'Hardware' price bucket (Hardware__c is a record lookup; no 'Hardware' Fortra_Product_Type value), so 'four buckets' should read 'three buckets'; (2) 'Software perpetual' belongs to type 'Perpetual', which is deliberately unbucketed, so buckets are partial sub-sums and are NOT contractually equal to the header. If a future requirement genuinely needs buckets to reconcile to the header, the three Total* AdvancedListFilters would have to cover every Fortra_Product_Type value (add Perpetual/Maintenance/Hardware buckets or widen Software to include Perpetual) AND match the header's DerivedPricingAttribute=isFalse gate that the category steps currently omit (described, not applied).
notes: Active proc Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure V21 (9QBWC0000000oWH4AY) confirmed Active. Branch trace: steps 116 Total Services / 117 Total Software / 118 Total Subscription = AdvancedListFilter Equals Fortra_Product_Type__c -> Services/Software/Subscription Aggregate Price (GroupingAndAggregatePricing SUM ItemNetTotalPrice, where ItemNetTotalPrice isNotNull) -> Total_*__c. Header Subtotal/Total Amount aggregate with DerivedPricingAttribute isNotNull AND isFalse (excludes derived/maintenance lines). KEY STRUCTURAL FACT matching SC-3345 memory's documented follow-up ('category totals don't reconcile to GrandTotal'): category buckets LACK the DerivedPricingAttribute gate the header has AND cover only 3 of ~9 type values -> partial sub-sums by design, not an exhaustive partition. The genuinely testable C-07 assertion (isolation: each line in exactly one bucket, no double-counting, no cross-contamination) PASSES exactly on live repriced data. The 'buckets sum to header' sub-clause and the 'four buckets incl Hardware' framing are EXPECTATION-ERRORs (no defect). Empty-bucket reset (K-05 ref): an absent type leaves its Total_*__c unwritten/null (quote 0Q0WC000002QRDz0AO shows all three null because its lines net null and are excluded by isNotNull); no stale carryover observed on the repriced control. No DML fixture needed - validated on an existing UI-priced multi-type quote (the brief's preferred path). No deploys/edits; validation-only.
verdict_reason: Category-bucket routing/isolation works correctly on live repriced data (Software 27354 / Services 24275 / Subscription 5775.5, each from only its own Fortra_Product_Type__c lines, zero double-counting), and the header Subtotal=74909.5 = SUM of all non-derived lines is correct; the catalog's 'four buckets incl Hardware sum to the header' is an expectation error (V21 has 3 partial sub-sum buckets by design; Perpetual/Hardware are intentionally unbucketed and Hardware__c is a record lookup not a subtotal), not a procedure defect.
